findings.per_finding_granularity_violation_shape: The single FREEZE-triage finding ('drop _for_test on Engine via Row D-7') covered 1 of 115 instances of a workspace-pattern bug. Per §3.6b sub-rule 4 sub-clause 2 (deferral-destination granularity), a workspace-pattern bug with 115 instances should either be (a) closed in a single sweep at FREEZE-time as an umbrella fix-now, or (b) named to a SPECIFIC deferral row (e.g. Row D-22 "workspace _for_test → testing-module/feature-flag relocation sweep") with the 115 sites enumerated or counted. The current shape (1 site named, 114 silently locked) is the pattern §3.6b sub-rule 4 forbids: umbrella-named exposure with finding-level closure.

disposition_options.(a) FIX-NOW orchestrator-direct sweep (p: Add #[cfg(any(test, feature = "testing"))] gating to all 115 surfaces + regenerate 6 baselines + run §3.5h workspace pre-push. LOC estimate: ~150-200 LOC (mostly cfg-attr lines + 6 baseline regen). The brief for each implementer said 'gated by #[cfg(test)] or a testing feature; this is the SAME pattern as Cid::sample_for_test' — this is closing the brief's stated discipline as orchestrator-direct cleanup, not new design.
disposition_options.(b) DEFER-NAMED-NOW to NEW V1-FROZEN-INT: Author Row D-22 'workspace pub fn _for_test → testing-module-or-feature-flag relocation sweep' enumerating all 115 sites (or citing this finding's count + crate breakdown). Couple with a no-regression test pin that asserts new pub fn _for_test surfaces require either #[cfg] gating or a Row D-22 citation. Cost: ~50-80 LOC for Row D-22 + ~30-50 LOC for the pin. Defers the bytes-fix to G-COMP-1.
disposition_options.(c) DISAGREE-WITH-EXPLANATION: Argue that V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md:154 was always intended to apply to the Engine §8-A cluster ONLY (not workspace-wide). If this disposition is chosen, retense V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md:154 to scope-restrict the prohibition, document the workspace-wide _for_test surface as ratified-by-baseline, and note the precedent (Cid::sample_for_test gates) is now non-uniform.

findings.recommended_disposition: (a) FIX-NOW orchestrator-direct sweep — lowest risk (closes the brief's stated discipline as cleanup, not new design), zero v1-beta behaviour impact (visibility-only change to the test-helper surfaces), preserves the V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md:154 rule's load-bearing property (no silent _for_test on public surface), is the agent-economics-thorough-cleanup default per memory. Couples to the upcoming baseline regen at G-CORE-9 R5 next iteration so the fix lands atomically with the next baseline refresh.
